description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Optical Zonu Corp. is seeking a Software Engineer to develop applications connecting its hardware products with production operations, engineering teams, customers, and internal systems. The role focuses on Python applications and graphical interfaces, hardware integration, automated testing, diagnostics, and tools that improve engineering workflows.
Software Engineer developing Python GUI applications and automation tools to configure, test, diagnose, and support hardware products

Responsibilities:
• Develop Python applications with intuitive graphical interfaces for production, engineering, and customer use
• Build software tools to configure, monitor, test, and diagnose hardware products
• Integrate applications with databases and existing company systems
• Create automated testing, diagnostic, and production-support tools
• Test, debug, document, and release reliable, maintainable software
• Work with production and quality assurance teams to establish procedures and train users on software tools
• Collaborate with firmware, electrical, production, and software engineers to support product development and integration
• Develop automation and AI-assisted tools to improve engineering workflows and productivity

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
• Strong proficiency in Python and experience developing maintainable applications
• Experience building graphical user interfaces using Qt or a similar framework
• Experience integrating software with hardware, instruments, or external systems
• Solid software engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, modular design, abstraction, testing, debugging, and maintainability
• Experience working with databases and structured data
• Systematic approach to problem-solving and debugging
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities

Preferred:
• Experience developing applications for production, manufacturing, testing, or diagnostics
• Experience developing applications in C on Linux
• Familiarity with Git, JIRA, and collaborative software development tools
• Experience with AWS or another cloud platform
• Experience with automated testing or validation systems
• Familiarity with AI and large language model tools, agents, or workflow automation
